headline: Binance Lifts Withdrawal Suspension Following $6.3 Billion Security Breach
summary: Crypto platform Binance announced the completion of withdrawal recovery work, lifting its suspension following a record $6.3 billion hack.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and prolonged interruptions or massive security breaches pose systemic liquidity and confidence risks to digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Restoring normal operations on the world's largest exchange removes a major liquidity overhang for the wider crypto market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The resumption of normal platform operations alleviates trader fears regarding asset lockups following a historic exchange exploit.
